transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess... what brings me in is that I’ve been waking up with this heavy, hollow sadness. It's just... it's like the studio lights are on, but there’s no music in me anymore, if that makes sense. I just feel really down.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hollow sadness?
I'd say... it's been about nine months now. Yeah, nine months of feeling this way.
Do you find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed a change with that, to be honest. I still enjoy dancing and working on new choreography. It's just... that heavy feeling is always there in the background while I'm doing it.
Have you noticed any decrease in the pleasure you get from activities you normally enjoy, even if it's just a little bit?

No, not really. I mean, like I said, I still like dancing and putting together routines. It's just that I feel sad while I'm doing it. But the actual enjoyment of the dancing hasn't really gone away or decreased.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried about anything lately?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really been feeling anxious or worried about anything specific. It's... it's really just that heavy sadness I was talking about. But no, no real anxiety or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep pattern?

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty all over the place, honestly. Um... there were some nights where I was just staying up sketching formations until dawn. But lately, it's different. I'll fall asleep completely exhausted, and then I just wake up at four or five in the morning with my stomach feeling really tight. So, yeah, it's definitely been off.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite?

Yeah, definitely. When I was buzzing with all those ideas for the routines, I would just skip meals completely and not even notice. But now... now it's different. Food just tastes like cardboard to me. I've actually noticed my rehearsal clothes are hanging a lot looser than they usually do, so I guess I've lost some weight.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels or how you've been moving lately?

Yeah, my energy has definitely tanked. I just feel... really heavy. Recently, even just crossing the studio to pick up my notebook feels incredibly slowed down. It's like... like my body is moving through wet sand instead of music. I just don't have the energy to move the way I'm used to.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, no I haven't. Um... I know I feel really low right now, but I haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or... or ending things. I just feel really drained, but nothing like that.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah, like I was just saying a minute ago, I'm definitely moving a lot slower. Um, just like I mentioned about crossing the studio... everything physical just feels really dragged out right now. I'm not totally sure if I'm talking slower, but my body definitely feels like it's stuck in that wet sand I was telling you about. It just takes so much more time and effort to do basic things.
Do you think your slowed movements are noticeable to other people, like your friends or fellow dancers?

Yeah, I think they probably do. Like I was saying before about just crossing the studio to get my notebook... when it takes me that much effort and feels that slow to me, I'm sure it looks slow to them, too. Dancers pay a lot of attention to movement. So if I'm dragging around like I'm stuck in wet sand instead of actually moving to the music, my fellow dancers are definitely going to notice it. They haven't really said anything to me about it yet, but I'm pretty sure it's obvious.
How much weight would you say you've lost since you started feeling this way?

I'm not exactly sure on the number of pounds, but... my rehearsal clothes have definitely been hanging a lot looser on me lately. When I was, you know, buzzing with all those ideas a while back, I'd just skip meals without even noticing because I was so busy. And now... I just don't have an appetite. Food kind of tastes like cardboard to me right now. So yeah, I've definitely lost some weight.
Would you say that your slowed movements are severe enough to interfere with your daily activities or dancing routines?

Yeah, it's definitely interfering. I mean, I'm still showing up for the absolute essentials, but I'm just not functioning like I normally do. I actually fell behind on my teaching prep recently, and I completely missed a grant deadline because I just couldn't get it together. My studio got so chaotic that some of my collaborators actually had to step in and start handling basic scheduling for me. So, yeah, it's definitely affecting my work as a choreographer and a teacher.
Have you lost interest in things you used to care about?

I haven't really noticed a loss of interest, no. I mean, I still care about dancing and my students. It's just harder to do it all right now because I'm so exhausted and slow, but the interest is still there.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?

Yeah, I do. I just keep... replaying those cancelled performances in my head. I keep telling myself that I really let everyone down—the dancers, the funders, the whole community. I mean, people have been a lot kinder about it than I actually deserve, but... yeah, I definitely blame myself a lot right now.
Would you say that your feelings of guilt or self-blame are overwhelming or interfere significantly with your daily life?

I wouldn't say they're overwhelming. I mean, I definitely feel bad about it, and I think about it a lot, but it's not like... it's not stopping me from doing what I need to do. It's more of a persistent thought than something that completely derails my day.
Have you been feeling restless or having trouble sitting still lately?

Not restless, no. It's actually the opposite. I feel really... slowed down lately. Even just crossing the studio to pick up my notebook takes so much effort. It feels like my body is moving through wet sand instead of music.
Would you describe your current sadness as being most of the day or nearly every day?

No, I don't think it's like that. I mean, I definitely feel down when I think about the cancelled shows and letting people down, but it's not... it's not an all-day thing. It comes and goes, so I wouldn't say I'm sad most of the day or every single day.
Would you say that your feelings of sadness are present for more than half of the days since you started feeling this way?

No, probably not. I mean, it's definitely less than half the days. Like I was saying, it really just hits me when I'm dwelling on the studio or the shows I had to cancel. But a lot of days I don't feel sad at all... so, no, I wouldn't say it's more than half the time.
